_source: Claude desktop app, claude.ai IndexedDB (IndexedDB/https_claude.ai_0.indexeddb.leveldb), database keyval-store, object store keyval, key store:pin-state:dframe-starred-code. Captured 2026-09-18 on Arman's Mac with ccl_chromium_reader.WrappedIndexDB over a copy of the store (LOCK removed). Ids scrubbed; the VALUE SHAPE (a JSON string with state.starredIds, version, updatedAt) and the account-switch write sequence are verbatim: the app rewrote the key EMPTY at 10:27:00.245 and refilled it at 10:27:00.786. Every stored version is kept by LevelDB, so a reader sees all of them; the one with the highest updatedAt is the signed-in account's list.
